values.note: Booked on South Carolina State Parks' own reservation site or 1-866-345-7275, up to 13 months ahead. 'Minimum length of stay is 2 nights'; per AWH's firsthand report on the state:SC row, a single night can be booked by calling the park within a week of arrival. Maximum 14 nights per site (cumulative up to 42 of 49). Same-day reservations go through the park (864-391-2450). Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon.

note: Packed-gravel sites on Lake Thurmond (Strom Thurmond Reservoir), internal roads rough. Boat ramps closed for low lake levels (park page, 2026-10-21). --Claude
